Meeting Date: October 14, 2010
Inflation Developments
Inflation was generally moderate across all other subcategories.
While annual services inflation continued to decrease steadily, core inflation indicators remained in line with medium-term targets.
1. Consumer prices picked up by 1.23 percent in September and annual inflation rose by 0.91 percentage points to 9.24 percent.
The rise in annual inflation was due to the sharp increase in unprocessed food prices.
Annual inflation in food and nonalcoholic beverages increased by 4.96 percentage points to 15.33 percent in September due to continued upswings in unprocessed food prices.
